instruction.text: In the UK, we get lots of cold weather. Find the frosty ground to learn more.

feedback.end: Frost happens when water droplets on the ground freezes. During the winter, we often get frost in the mornings.

instruction.text: This is another kind of cold weather. Find the snowy ground to learn more.

feedback.end: It snows when clouds freeze instead of turning into rain. Snowy weather is more common in the mountains of Scotland and Northern England than in the rest of the country.

instruction.text: Can you find the warning sign next to the road?
What do you think this sign is a warning for?

feedback.correct: Correct! We get ice when it is very cold and water freezes. This normally happens at the same time as frost or snow. Ice is very slippery, so it can be dangerous for cars.
